entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-15
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Removing "artifacts" from ArtifactsPath cases error #48991
  • file-based program can't find versioned package-based SDK reference #48990
  • dotnet completions for bash disables tab complete of file names #48988
  • There doesn't appear to be an easy way to disable StaticWebAssets caching functionality #48985
  • APICompat, GenAPI, and ApiDiff need support for extension everything #48983
  • Url path ignored when using resiliency #48979
  • dotnet cannot install on Debian Trixie from official MS packages because libicu76 is too new #48973

Closed

  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/9.0.3xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #48866
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/9.0.2xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #48865
  • dotnet watch crash with Aspire and BlazorWASM #48924
